title: Secure sign-in and sessions with Express
description: At Kilnworth Pottery every change to the workshops still needs one shared staff key, and by now that key has been passed around far too much. Give each member of staff a sign-in of their own: passwords kept only as salted hashes, a sign-in that gives nothing away, sessions in cookies scripts cannot read, routes that know who may do what, and sessions that end. You learn how a real sign-in is built, and why each tempting shortcut is unsafe.
